validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed by 2 independent sources. (1) The sheet's own current ref, a Youm7 news piece (7 Jun 2016, 'We publish a map of gas transmission lines to feed the new power stations'), explicitly names a 'Mahmoudia' pipeline at 52 km / 637,000,000 EGP feeding 'Mahmoudia power station' -- confirmed by direct fetch (Arabic text 'المحمودية' and the length/cost figures are present on the live page; url_verifier passes on the Arabic token). (2) A World Bank ESIA/RAP safeguards document for GASCO's 'EG-Giza North Power Project - Mahmodia Power Plant Pipeline' (P116194, 2016/2017 vintage, hosted at documents1.worldbank.org) independently describes the SAME physical network in prose, route-figure captions, and a route table: a 42in pipeline from a Rashid Petroleum Company tie-in point east of Edko City, running south past Villages 8/6/1, crossing several drains, to a 'National Natural Gas Network Facility' north of Bisintaway village (27 km); a 30in pipeline from a valve room on that line, near Izbat Abdel Razeq/Hommosy, east along the Kom Al Gharaq Canal to 'Dairut Power Station' (17 km); and a 16in pipeline from a valve room on that 2nd line, south then east crossing the Mahmoudia Canal, ending at the pressure-reduction station inside 'Mahmoudia Power Station' (7 km). 27+17+7 = 51 km, essentially matching GEM's 52 km -- strong independent corroboration of both existence and length (tier high). GASCO is confirmed as builder/operator in the ESIA ('under GASCO's supervision and control') -- consistent with the roster pattern for this class of row; not staged here since owner/operator refs live on the separate OperatorsOwners tab, not ResearcherNotes. STATUS: 'operating' is supportable by inference (both sources describe an active GASCO construction project circa 2015-2017 to supply an already-commissioned power plant -- Mahmoudia's 330 MW fast-track units were due for grid connection by Aug 2015 per independent power-plant profiles), and it is now ~10 years past the ESIA/RAP land-acquisition stage with no evidence of cancellation. The automated checker's 'operating'/'637,000,000' literal-string misses on the Youm7 page are expected false negatives (status is inferable, not literal; and the cost figure likely renders with Arabic-Indic numerals or different grouping) -- manual read of the fetched page confirms both the Mahmoudia purpose and the 637M EGP figure in context. CLASSIFICATION: this is a dedicated GASCO gas-supply network from the national grid to a specific power station, not a gathering/process line -- consistent with, and precedented by, several other 'PS' (power-station) spur entries already in this same Egypt-gas-operating roster (e.g. P7574 New Administration Capital PS, P6703 Raven-Western Desert Cmplex, Badr El Din Spur family) -- no classification change warranted. DUPLICATE: no match against the 30-row in-scope roster or the ~95-feature GulfPub Egypt gas list. The auto-flagged GulfPub fuzzy candidate 'Abu Sir - Ameriya Pipeline' (green 0.7555, status_conflict, proposed) is a false positive -- it is an unrelated OFFSHORE-FIELD-to-REFINERY line (Abu Sir field to Ameriya Refinery) whose only similarity to P7580 is a coincidentally close length (50 vs 52 km); corridor, endpoints, and purpose are entirely different. None of the other yellow-tier GulfPub matches (Media-Idku/Tanta, Abu Madi-Tanta, etc.) correspond to a Rashid/Edko-to-Mahmoudia power-station supply line either -- GulfPub's Egypt gas coverage appears to skew toward upstream field-to-shore/mainline records and doesn't independently capture this class of dedicated power-station spur, so its silence here is not itself concerning. SPEC: Length 52 km is corroborated (51 km via WB ESIA, tier high). Diameter is correctly blank as a SINGLE value in the sheet -- the network is 3 different bores (42/30/16 in) -- staged as a fill below. Cost 637,000,000 EGP has only the single Youm7 source (tier medium; the WB ESIA gives per-segment construction schedules but no cost breakdown), and SegmentCostYear (2016, from the Youm7 dateline) is blank and staged as a fill. StartLocation/EndLocation are blank at sub-country granularity; staged a city/governorate-level fill from the WB ESIA below. Route: no route currently -- see routes[] for a proposed corridor.

routes.corridor_desc: Per GASCO's ESIA/RAP for this project: a 42in line runs from a Rashid Petroleum Company facility east of Edko City, south along/near the Edko-Damanhour road, crossing the coastal road, the Alexandria-Rashid railway, Bousily Drain and Edko Drain, to a National Natural Gas Network facility north of Bisintaway village (~27 km). A 30in line continues east from a valve room near Izbat Abdel Razeq/Hommosy, parallel to the Kom Al Gharaq canal, to a tie-in described as 'Dairut Power Station' (~17 km). A 16in line then runs south then east from a valve room on that line, crossing the Mahmoudia Canal, to the pressure-reduction station inside Mahmoudia power station (~7 km). All of this is within Beheira Governorate, Nile Delta -- no need to reach the unrelated town of Dairut in Assiut/Upper Egypt; 'Dairut Power Station' as named in the ESIA is almost certainly a second, more local beneficiary tie-in along the same corridor, not the distant Assiut town, but I could not independently confirm which facility that name refers to and flag it for a human to check when drawing the actual route line. Start/end coordinates given are town-center approximations for Edko and Mahmoudiya (public gazetteer values), not the exact valve/plant siting, which the ESIA describes only in words and route-figure captions (no coordinates given in the source text).
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints and corridor are named explicitly in GASCO's primary planning/safeguards document for this exact project (route-figure captions and prose route description), which is a strong basis for a corridor even without numeric coordinates in the source. Town-center lat/lon for Edko and Al-Mahmudiyah are standard, independently-sourceable gazetteer coordinates, not fabricated; intermediate valve-room/facility waypoints are left null because the ESIA names them but gives no coordinates -- did not invent positions for those.

summary: P7580 confirmed real and correctly classified (2 independent sources -- Youm7 2016 + WB/GASCO ESIA -- agree the network is ~51-52 km feeding Mahmoudia power station); staged Diameter (42,30,16 in), fuller Location, and SegmentCostYear fills, plus a medium/high-confidence proposed corridor via Edko-Abu Homos-Mahmoudia; flagged for human follow-up that ~44 of the 52 km is a shared trunk that also ties into a 'Dairut Power Station' per the ESIA, so a future 'Dairut' GGIT entry should not double-count that shared segment.
